thread:
marco: starting a follow-up on canary pivot autopilot ideas. we need to finalize operator handoff, and make the autopilot auditable and reversible.
anya: quick ask 1 do we let proxies make persistent pivots, or only ephemeral leases? persistent ones complicate audits.
liam: prefer ephemeral first. control plane can then escalate to persistent if patterns hold (eg 5min sustained regression).
marco: agreed. ephemeral leases solve most split-brain. propose lease hierarchy: proxy lease (short), regional arbitrator lease (medium), control plane persistent marker (long).
serena: signals list: p95 latency, error_rate, model_confidence_delta, token_cost_spike. also health checks. dev-bot: metric bridge updated to push token_cost_spike and confidence delta for canary models. :rocket:
niko: to reduce flapping, require two consecutive windows to trigger, and add TTL jitter so we don't stampede. also slow ramp for cache-warmup: introduce 'grace_keys' that are sticky for 10s.
anya: sticky keys idea is great but could leak user affinity. limit to internal session ids only.
marco: draft local policy gist: policy { local_enabled:true, signals:["p95","5xx","conf_delta"], window_s:20, min_requests:40, agree_count:2, lease_s:12, ramp_pct:[10,40,100], ramp_step_s:15, jitter_s:5 }
liam: note: make lease_s overrideable per route. batch endpoints can have longer leases.
serena: operator handoff checklist: 1) one-click emergency revert in console 2) timeline view of pivots 3) per-variant cache-warmth metric 4) reconciliation audit showing conflicts and resolution.
marco: API contract between proxy and control plane: decidePivot(session_id, route, recent_signals)->{variant, lease_s, reason, signature, ttl}. proxies accept signed decisions only to avoid rogue pivots.
anya: security note: decisions must be signed with KMS and replay-protected with idempotency token.
liam: testing plan: chaos test that kills the model worker and flips quality; assert that pivot occurs within lease_s and rollbacks within backoff window.
dev-bot: automated test scheduled: canary-pivot-chaos at 03:00 UTC tomorrow.
serena: followups: marco to PR policy proto + annotated runbook, anya to security design for decision signing, niko to dashboard mocks. weekly review Fri 11:00.
marco: thanks all, keeping this thread open for small tweaks.
